Notifications are interactive - clicking opens detail modal with full content, mark as read works, mark all read works. Restricted user (marinini28@gmail.com) correctly blocked from bank transfer.

context_for_next_testing_agent: Bank Transfer Proof Upload and Interactive Notifications fully tested. Key features: 1) /withdraw-methods page - clicking 'Transferencia Bancaria' opens dialog, clicking 'Ya realice la transferencia' opens proof upload modal with file upload (JPG/PNG/PDF max 5MB), optional comment, and submit button. 2) Backend POST /api/payments/bank-transfer-confirm accepts proof_file (base64), proof_filename, comment fields. Validates file extension and size. Sends emails via Resend (may fail without valid API key but saves to DB). 3) Notification bell in sidebar header opens dropdown with clickable notifications. Clicking notification opens detail modal with full content. Mark as read changes styling (muted, no green dot). Mark all read button hides badge. 4) marinini28@gmail.com blocked from bank transfer (frontend hides card, backend returns 403).

notification_system.read_styling: muted colors, no green dot, no bold text

mocked_apis.note: Resend email sending may fail without valid API key, but endpoint saves record to DB successfully
